answers.how: The ball’s fall gives a pixel acceleration of about 227 px/s², so the scale is 23.2 px/m. Its diameter is about 9 px.
Using the gravity-derived scale of 23.2 px/m, the forklift’s approximately 134 px total length converts to 5.8 m.
Using the gravity-derived scale of 23.2 px/m, the forklift’s approximately 93 px height converts to 4.0 m.
